full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white photograph shows a small dark house on an open snow-covered plain beneath an immense bank of storm clouds. The horizon lies low, leaving the upper two thirds to a turbulent charcoal sky. At the upper center, broken luminous gaps open through thick clouds, with white light diffusing across softer gray vapor. A heavy dark mass descends on the left, nearly touching the flat horizon and making the scene feel pressed downward. Just right of center along the distant ground stands the house, its pitched roof lightly dusted with snow. White window frames punctuate the dark façade, and two short chimney forms rise from the roofline. A faint wire stretches from the house toward the right edge, where small pale distant structures recede into haze. The foreground is a wide field of thinly ridged snow and wind-smoothed gray texture. A narrow dark road or track cuts horizontally across the lower middle, separating near ground from the house's slightly raised bank. No people are visible; the building is the only firm vertical anchor in the exposed landscape. The light is entirely filtered through cloud breaks, striking the snow with muted silver values while the underside of the storm remains almost black. Fine photographic grain and soft atmospheric falloff distinguish the dense nearer cloud from the paler distance. The composition keeps the house deliberately small beneath the weather, using dramatic tonal scale and broad empty ground to suggest isolation. The overall image is stark and contemplative, balancing crisp architectural detail with overwhelming, luminous gray cloud texture.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白照片呈现一幢深色小屋立在开阔的积雪平原上，头顶是浩大的暴风云层。地平线很低，上方三分之二留给翻涌的炭灰天空。上方中央，厚云被几道明亮裂口打开，白光漫射在较柔的灰色水汽中。沉重暗云从左侧垂下，几乎触及平坦地平线，让画面仿佛受到向下的压迫。靠近远处地面中央偏右，小屋立着，尖屋顶轻覆积雪。白色窗框点亮深色立面，屋脊上有两道矮烟囱形体。一条模糊线缆从小屋伸向右边缘，那里几处浅色远方结构退入雾气。前景是宽阔雪野，带浅浅脊纹和被风抚平的灰色肌理。一道狭窄深色路或车辙水平切过中下部，把近地面与小屋略高的地基分开。看不见人物，建筑是暴露景色中唯一坚实的竖向锚点。光完全经过云隙过滤，让积雪呈现低调银色明度，暴风云底则近乎黑色。细微摄影颗粒和柔和空气衰减将较密的近云与更浅的远方区分开。构图有意让小屋在天气下显得很小，借戏剧化明度尺度和宽阔空地暗示孤立。整体画面严峻而沉思，以清晰的建筑细节平衡压倒性、发亮的灰色云肌理。
style_prompt_en: The black-and-white photography uses a broad gray scale, from deep charcoal masses to diffused silver-white openings. Large turbulent tonal areas dominate, while a small precise dark accent anchors the lower zone. Fine grain and atmospheric softness give transitions physical weight without losing the shape of the brightest breaks. A low horizontal division and extensive negative space emphasize scale; small linear details add measure but never crowd the frame. Cloud-filtered illumination creates luminous patches rather than a single hard spotlight, while near-black undersides heighten drama. Subtle surface ridges remain visible in the pale lower field. The overall effect is austere, weathered, and contemplative, with strong emotional force arising from value proportion and distance.
style_prompt_zh: 这种黑白摄影使用宽阔灰阶，从深炭黑团块过渡到漫射银白裂口。大片翻涌的明度区域占主导，下方一处小而精确的深色重音稳住画面。细微颗粒和空气柔化让过渡有物理重量，却不丢失最亮开口的形状。低位水平分界与大范围留白强调尺度，细小线性细节提供参照，却不使画面拥挤。云层过滤的照明产生片状亮光，而非单个硬朗聚光点，近黑底面则增强戏剧性。下方浅色区域仍可见轻微表面脊纹。整体效果简峻、风化而沉思，强烈情绪来自明度比例与距离感。
theme_en: A solitary dark house beneath vast storm clouds on a snowy plain
theme_zh: 雪原上孤立的深色小屋与浩大暴风云
name: Ragnar Axelsson
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
